expo._comment_base: Everything the FOUR shipped apps SHARE. `app.config.js` reads this and overrides name / slug / scheme / package id per variant (APP_VARIANT=shop|manufacturer|distributor|regional — `partner` was retired on 2026-08-08). The four values below are placeholders that a real build always replaces — edit app.config.js, not these.
expo.name: RoadMate Business

extra._comment_apiUrl: Overridden per environment. A phone cannot reach the API on localhost — this must be the dev machine's LAN address (see .env.example).
extra._comment_variant: ⚠️ Do NOT add a `variant` block here. `eas build` writes the RESOLVED config back into this file, which once baked `{key:'shop'}` in — harmless only because `app.config.js` spreads `...config.extra` first and then overwrites `variant` with the computed one. A stale copy here is a snapshot of whichever variant was built last, and it becomes a live bug the day that merge order changes.

expo._comment_variants: HANDOFF §4, revised 2026-08-08: this codebase ships as FOUR Play Store listings — RoadMate Shop, Manufacturer, Distributor and Regional — via Expo app variants in `app.config.js`. Six listings platform-wide, still three codebases. ⚠️ All four variants currently share `assets/icon.png`; distinct icons are needed before store submission.
expo._comment_icons: TODO(design): all FOUR business apps need their own icons and store screenshots — Shop, Manufacturer, Distributor, Regional. Same accent (#DEBE10), different mark each. Not a code change — assets only, but four sets since the 2026-08-08 six-app split.
